title: Avorria RC Commercial Launch Pricing Policy
description: Authoritative margin and markup settings by product category. Configured for Avorria launch.
notes: Landed cost is calculated server-side: (Supplier Net EUR + Inbound Freight EUR) * (1 + Customs Tariff) * FX Rate.
Markup percentage is added to Landed Cost to determine Ex-Tax Retail Price.
UK storefront displays VAT-inclusive price (+20%). US storefront displays pre-tax price.
Landed cost and gross margin are strictly confidential and NEVER exposed to the storefront API.
Gross Margin % = ((ExTax - Landed) / ExTax) * 100. Note that 35% markup yields 25.93% gross margin.

COMPLETE_KIT.name: Complete Car Kits (e.g. MTC2R, MBX8R, MRX6X, MSX1)
COMPLETE_KIT.example_note: Mathematically verified: €529.00 net kit + €15.00 shipping * 1.02 duty = €554.88 landed (€473.98 GBP @ 0.8542). 35% markup gives £639.87 ex-tax (25.93% gross margin). +20% UK VAT = £767.85, rounding whole to £768.00 inc VAT.

OPTION_PART.name: Option & Hop-Up Parts (Carbon, Titanium, Aluminum upgrades)
OPTION_PART.example_note: Mathematically verified: €20.00 net part + €1.50 shipping * 1.02 duty = €21.93 landed (£18.73 GBP @ 0.8542). 50% markup gives £28.10 ex-tax (33.33% gross margin). +20% UK VAT = £33.72, rounding to 50p = £33.50 inc VAT.
